Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Itsuwari no Yuusha Denshou
meta.description: The war is over, but General Drel's secrets remain. As visitors from Hiden, Boelate, and Eslinn converge on Solsein, Boelate's divine academy, the search for Drel's hidden room begins. Among those drawn into the mystery is Klen, now serving as Luna's magic teacher. But what truth lies at the heart of Drel's secret?

videos.title: Solsein, the Divine Academy
videos.overview: Klen and Alicia head to a school in search of Drel's secret room.

videos.title: Another World
videos.overview: Alicia digs deeper into the mysteries of Solsein.

videos.title: The Hero Legend and the Village of Origin
videos.overview: The secrets of the hero legend are revealed.

videos.title: The Dark Tower
videos.overview: Klen takes bold action to lure out Vordin.

videos.title: Battle With Oneself
videos.overview: Alicia fights her doppelganger in a strange world.

videos.title: Whispering Voice
videos.overview: Vordin manipulates the students in an all-out battle against Klen.

videos.title: The World We See, And the Hidden World
videos.overview: Alicia learns about the second world hidden in the mirror, as the battle between Klen and Solsein continues.

videos.title: Memories of a Friend
videos.overview: Ray challenges Klen, and questions where he got his face.

videos.title: The Mirror Labyrinth
videos.overview: Milea puts her plan into motion in the hidden world.

videos.title: Second Trial
videos.overview: Alicia faces Milea in the hidden world.

videos.title: What's Reflected in the Mirror
videos.overview: Clevatess begins his battle with Vordin as Alicia is trapped in a cold illusion.

videos.title: The Millennium of a Dark Beast Lord
videos.overview: The true hero's story is revealed.

videos.title: True Hero
videos.overview: Clevatess's battle with Vordin concludes as a new foe appears.
